changes.compareHint: The state at that moment is rebuilt from the local history and recalculated with the same rules.
changes.beforeHistoryText: History started on {date}. Earlier changes were not recorded, so they cannot be rebuilt. The first comparable date is {earliest}.
changes.useHistoryStart: Compare from the start of history
changes.cutTitle: Data was replaced after that date
changes.cutText: On {date} a backup was restored or the demo was reset. Earlier states cannot be rebuilt.
changes.future: Choose a date that is not in the future.
changes.reconciled: The breakdown adds up exactly to the difference.
changes.unexplainedText: Some data changed without being recorded in the history (for example, edited from another app version). It is not attributed to any cause.
changes.neutral_one: {count} recorded change did not affect available.
changes.neutral_other: {count} recorded changes did not affect available.
changes.dailyNote: Even if you record nothing, the per-day figure changes: the same money is split over fewer days, and a new period starts when income arrives.
changes.horizonMoved: The period ended on {from}; now it ends on {to}.
changes.noSteps: You recorded no changes since then.
changes.basis.registered: Balances, transactions, goals and payments are the ones you recorded, before and after each change.
changes.basis.estimate: Scheduled payments marked as “approximate” are reserved at their estimated amount.
changes.basis.assumption: The next income date defines the period; it is assumed to arrive that day, but it is never added before you receive it.
changes.basis.rules: Both figures use the current rules. History started on {date}.
